hero_kpi_rationale: Concentrate operations represent Coca-Cola's historical and most profitable business model (59% of revenue but 85% of volume), with gross margins higher than finished product operations

kpis.name: Concentrate Operations Revenue
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue generated from the sale of beverage concentrates and syrups to partner bottlers
kpis.description: Concentrate operations account for 59% of total company revenue, sustaining the high-margin business model

kpis.name: Finished Product Operations Revenue
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue generated from the direct sale of finished beverages to retailers and distributors
kpis.description: Finished product operations represent 41% of total revenue, primarily through consolidated bottling operations
kpis.signal: Stable revenue for finished product operations

kpis.name: Concentrate Operations Volume Share
kpis.explanation: Share of global unit case volume generated by concentrate operations versus finished products
kpis.description: 85% of global volume comes from concentrate operations, demonstrating the effectiveness of the partnership model with bottlers
kpis.signal: Dominance of the asset-light model through the network of partner bottlers

risks.title: Asset Impairment
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded significant impairment charges of $760 million in 2024 and $960 million in 2025, due to revised projections and macroeconomic changes. These recurring and increasing amounts demonstrate material exposure.

risks.title: Deterioration of Operating Results
risks.score_rationale: Intense competitive pressure in the beverage industry, changing consumer habits, and rapid digitalization represent tangible threats to market share and profitability.

risks.title: Tax Risks
risks.score_rationale: Presence in over 200 countries exposes the company to major tax complexity with varying and evolving regulations. Regulatory uncertainty creates compliance and cost risks.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risks
risks.score_rationale: The impact of interest rate fluctuations on financing costs and cash flows is material in a context of financial market volatility and significant debt.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks
risks.score_rationale: Global presence with revenues, expenses, and assets in multiple currencies creates significant exposure to foreign exchange fluctuations explicitly mentioned in the risks.

risks.title: Pension Obligation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates and asset returns impact pension obligations, but risk level is moderate compared to other company exposures.

risks.title: AI and Emerging Technologies Regulatory Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: The uncertain and evolving AI regulatory framework could increase compliance costs or limit the use of these essential technologies for digital competitiveness.

ai_positioning.summary: Coca-Cola recognizes the impact of AI, data analytics, and automation on the digital competitive landscape and consumer behavior. The company mentions increasing use of AI in digital platforms that are transforming brand discovery and engagement. The uncertain and evolving AI regulatory framework is identified as a potential risk in terms of compliance costs and usage limitations.
evidence: The increasing use of data analytics, automation and artificial intelligence across digital platforms is further reshaping how consumers discover, evaluate and engage with brands.

The legal and regulatory landscape for certain new technologies, such as artificial intelligence, is uncertain and evolving, and our compliance obligations could increase our costs or limit how we may use these technologies.
